# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and fixes rendering and image-decoding behavior. The new SkiaSharp.Testing package supports image assertions and visual diagnostics. Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset boundaries. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move away from Linux x86 native assets** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Comparison results retain no native handles; returned difference images are caller-owned. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 image error recovery** — Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives. This includes PDF generation with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Windows ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Safer Ganesh texture-subset filtering** — Filtered sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid undefined exterior texels, and unsafe edge-touching direct copies are rejected. Texture-edge pixels may change. This affects Ganesh, not CPU or Graphite rendering. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection** — Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Zeroed runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are cleared instead of exposing leftover memory. Reset() clears the existing buffer in place, restoring documented zero values without allocating a replacement native block and wrapper. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
